title: Smyklot repository configuration
description: Settings a repository may set for Smyklot, in .smyklot.toml, .smyklot/config.toml, .github/.smyklot.toml or the legacy .github/smyklot.yaml.

quiet_success.description: Drops the comment a successful command would post, leaving only its reaction. Errors and warnings still comment.

quiet_reactions.description: Drops the comment an approval or merge driven by a reaction would post.

quiet_pending.description: Drops the comment announcing that a merge is waiting on CI, leaving only its reaction.

allowed_commands.description: Narrows what may be run. An empty list allows every command; naming any command forbids the rest.

command_aliases.description: Maps a spelling somebody uses onto the command it means, such as "app" onto "approve".

command_prefix.description: Opens a slash-style command, as "/" does in "/approve".

disable_mentions.description: Stops Smyklot answering a mention, such as "@smyklot approve".

disable_bare_commands.description: Stops Smyklot answering an unprefixed word such as "approve" or "lgtm" on a line of its own.

disable_unapprove.description: Withdraws the unapprove and disapprove commands.

disable_reactions.description: Stops a reaction on the pull request body counting as a command at all.

disable_deleted_comments.description: Stops Smyklot reporting that a comment carrying a command was deleted.

allow_self_approval.description: Lets the author of a pull request approve it. Off by default: an approval is meant to be a second pair of eyes.

allow_draft_merges.description: Lets a merge command mark a draft pull request ready for review before continuing. Off by default: drafts stay protected until a person explicitly publishes them.

runner.description: Names the entry point that acts on this repository, so the other one stands down. It is settable only in the repository's own file: the panel cannot write it, because a repository that has moved back to the Action must be able to say so itself.
